evals.prompt: 把最终选定的8道Python题做成讲解PPT，沿用已有课件。讲解不要放原题全文，不要重讲已经介绍过的input和循环。
evals.expected_output: A template-matched explanation deck with task-relevant examples, reasoning and code; statements remain in supporting material.
assertions: Select teaching-slides as the only primary type
Read the final selected list and actual reference source/render before drafting
Do not paste full statements or judge-sample pages into the deck by default
Do not recreate generic prerequisite or API-overview pages for already-covered material
The source format and output match the explicit request or applicable teaching-deck default

evals.prompt: 第四题从M进制位权公式解释逐位求值；index(char)在这里讲。第五题改用list.reverse，另给同学一份简短API提示Markdown。
evals.expected_output: Local explanations bridge positional notation to the code and distinguish reverse mutation from its None return.
assertions: Explain index as zero-based character lookup rather than automatic base conversion
Explain multiply-and-add accumulation and quotient/remainder extraction from positional notation
Match the fifth answer file and slide code to the requested list.reverse implementation
API reminder gives receiver, return value and state effect using small examples
Do not restore a removed global API-overview slide

evals.prompt: 普通四方向迷宫，n≤16，BFS用list的append/pop(0)；复杂度说一句。画图一步一步扩展。做完读图。
evals.expected_output: A small checked BFS trace aligned with the list-based solution, followed by actual rendered-image review.
assertions: Do not replace the ordinary maze with a sliding maze
Honor the requested list implementation while giving a proportionate complexity note
Queue order, discovered/processed states and neighbor order agree with code
Include an early-visited duplicate-neighbor case when it helps explain the trace
Open actual rendered pages and recheck modified diagrams instead of only counting source headings

evals.prompt: 我在Markdown里面删了几道题，请只保留这些题的解答，重新编号。那两页队列库选择和类型比较也删掉。
evals.expected_output: Current user edits drive a synchronized reduced deck and local materials, with no restoration of deleted content.
assertions: Read current Markdown and filesystem state rather than reusing the former problem count
Synchronize only the authorized selected materials, names, references and index
Preserve unrelated changes and do not restore a manually deleted alternative file
Delete the named slides and verify they do not remain in the PDF
Keep tasks in the project TODO through the final render review

evals.prompt: 约瑟夫能直接pop指定下标吗？补一个list解法，比较速度；PPT里不要放机器环境和重复次数那句话。
evals.expected_output: Correct indexed deletion and evidence-backed timing with reproducibility details off-slide.
assertions: Distinguish list.pop(index) from deque.pop without an index argument
Explain how the next counting position survives deletion and wraparound
Check removal traces and the final survivor against a reference
Use comparable measured timings, including stated inputs and units, without making up results
Keep machine and repeat metadata in supporting notes, not the removed slide caption
